directions: For this pa.rt, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay titled ''Are people becoming addicted to technology?". The statement given below is for your reference. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words. Numerous studies claim that addiction to technology is real and it has the same eff ect on the brain as drug addiction.
sample_essay:
Numerous studies claim that addiction to technology is real and it has the same effect on the brain as drug addiction. In modern society, it is quite evident that people are becoming increasingly addicted to technology.

To begin with, the convenience of technology makes it hard for people to resist. Smartphones, for example, offer a wide range of functions like social media, online shopping, and entertainment. People often find themselves constantly checking their phones, even in inappropriate situations. In addition, the immersive nature of technology, such as video games and virtual reality, can easily draw people in. Gamers may spend hours on end in front of the screen, neglecting their real-life responsibilities.

Furthermore, the social aspect of technology also contributes to addiction. Social media platforms keep people connected, but they can also create a sense of compulsion to constantly interact and seek validation. People may feel anxious when they are not able to check their social media accounts.

In conclusion, considering the various factors mentioned above, it is clear that people are indeed becoming addicted to technology. We should be aware of this issue and find a balance between the virtual and real world.
